newsitem.title: FINLAND: TAMROCK SELLS ITS VAMMAS STAKE TO PATRIA.
newsitem.headline: TAMROCK SELLS ITS VAMMAS STAKE TO PATRIA.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Tamrock Oy said in a statement on Friday it had sold its 22.3 percent stake in defence material company Vammas Oy to the recently created state-controlled defence group Patria Industries Oy.
The price was 41.5 million markka and Tamrock said it would book a profit of about six million markka on the disposal.
"Tamrock will gain about six million markka on this disposal," it said, adding it had decided to sell its shares, as the defence equipment business was not one of its core businesses.
